create_progress_bar_hook: create a ProgressBarHook instance to display a progress bar during batch processing in ClassyVision
register_progress_bar_hook: register the progress_bar hook using the register_hook decorator to enable progress tracking
on_phase_start_progress: start a progress bar at phase start by calling on_phase_start with a task object
update_progress_on_step: update the progress bar on each training step by calling on_step with the task
finish_progress_bar: finish and clear the progress bar at phase end by calling on_phase_end with the task
